editorial.blurb: Chicago's Pizza delivers iconic deep-dish pizza with serious attention to detail, from crispy bacon to thoughtfully executed gluten-free options that don't compromise on flavor.
editorial.insiderTip: Deep-dish pizzas take about 30 minutes to bake—worth the wait. Request the complimentary gluten-free focaccia as an appetizer, and consider ordering a deep-dish supreme with sausage, mushrooms, peppers, and onions.
